name: terra-3-scoped-page-selector
goal: Run page scenarios without component-catalog-only name filters.

evidence: The scoped platform page command received a component-catalog name filter and Playwright found no tests.
The entity-scope test covered preserving an existing selector but not page scenarios with their own test names.
The committed scope test failed because a page scenario acquired the catalog-only grep.
Only component-catalog checks get the entity-name grep; page scenario commands remain unchanged.
The unchanged scoped selector test passed at the separate fix commit.
